processing: ffmpeg: leading-silence trim (-55 dB), mono PCM16 at 32000 Hz, bounded length with 60 ms end fade. One shared peak gain (0.5) per root note. Roots verified by spectral pitch check; tuningCents is the measured mean per root (in the loop region for sustained instruments). Sustained instruments loop over whole fundamental periods with a 250 ms crossfade baked at playback.
